audit_status.source_base: Hebrew Deuteronomy / Devarim assembly, camp, escaped-slave, sexual-cult, interest, vow, and neighbor-harvest law, draft aligned later
audit_status.review_note: First-pass draft reviewed for genital-status and mamzer exclusions, Ammon/Moab restrictions, Edom/Egypt inclusion, camp emissions and sanitation, escaped-slave asylum, cult-prostitution language, interest, vows, and limited access to neighboring crops.

verses.restored: One wounded by crushing of testicles or whose male organ is cut shall not enter assembly of YHWH.

familiar.text: He that is wounded in the stones, or hath his privy member cut off, shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD.

modern.text: No man with crushed or severed genitals may enter the assembly of the LORD.

original.text: לֹֽא יָבֹ֧א פְצֽוּעַ דַּכָּ֛א וּכְר֥וּת שָׁפְכָ֖ה בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: A mamzer/person of prohibited union shall not enter assembly of YHWH; even tenth generation from him shall not enter assembly of YHWH.

familiar.text: A bastard shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to his tenth generation shall he not enter into the congregation of the LORD.

modern.text: No one of illegitimate birth may enter the assembly of the LORD, nor may any of his descendants, even to the tenth generation.

original.text: לֹא יָבֹ֥א מַמְזֵ֖ר בִּקְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם דּ֣וֹר עֲשִׂירִ֔י לֹא יָ֥בֹא ל֖וֹ בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter assembly of YHWH; even tenth generation from them shall not enter assembly of YHWH forever,

familiar.text: An Ammonite or Moabite shall not enter into the congregation of the LORD; even to their tenth generation shall they not enter into the congregation of the LORD for ever:

modern.text: No Ammonite or Moabite or any of their descendants may enter the assembly of the LORD, even to the tenth generation.

original.text: לֹֽא יָבֹ֧א עַמּוֹנִ֛י וּמוֹאָבִ֖י בִּקְהַ֣ל יְהוָ֑ה גַּ֚ם דּ֣וֹר עֲשִׂירִ֔י לֹא יָבֹ֥א לָהֶ֛ם בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָ֖ה עַד עוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: because they did not meet you with bread and water on way when you came out from Egypt, and because he hired against you Balaam son of Beor from Pethor of Aram-naharaim to curse you.

familiar.text: Because they met you not with bread and with water in the way, when ye came forth out of Egypt; and because they hired against thee Balaam the son of Beor of Pethor of Mesopotamia, to curse thee.

modern.text: For they did not meet you with food and water on your way out of Egypt, and they hired Balaam son of Beor from Pethor in Aram-naharaim to curse you.

original.text: עַל דְּבַ֞ר אֲשֶׁ֨ר לֹא קִדְּמ֤וּ אֶתְכֶם֙ בַּלֶּ֣חֶם וּבַמַּ֔יִם בַּדֶּ֖רֶךְ בְּצֵאתְכֶ֣ם מִמִּצְרָ֑יִם וַאֲשֶׁר֩ שָׂכַ֨ר עָלֶ֜יךָ אֶת בִּלְעָ֣ם בֶּן בְּע֗וֹר מִפְּת֛וֹר אֲרַ֥ם נַהֲרַ֖יִם לְקַֽלְלֶֽךָּ

verses.restored: But YHWH your Divine was unwilling to listen to Balaam, and YHWH your Divine turned curse into blessing for you, because YHWH your Divine loved you.

familiar.text: Nevertheless the LORD thy God would not hearken unto Balaam; but the LORD thy God turned the curse into a blessing unto thee, because the LORD thy God loved thee.

modern.text: Yet the LORD your God would not listen to Balaam, and the LORD your God turned the curse into a blessing for you, because the LORD your God loves you.

original.text: וְלֹֽא אָבָ֞ה יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ לִשְׁמֹ֣עַ אֶל בִּלְעָ֔ם וַיַּהֲפֹךְ֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֧יךָ לְּךָ֛ אֶת הַקְּלָלָ֖ה לִבְרָכָ֑ה כִּ֥י אֲהֵֽבְךָ֖ יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall not seek their peace or their prosperity all your days forever.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not seek their peace nor their prosperity all thy days for ever.

modern.text: You are not to seek peace or prosperity from them as long as you live.

original.text: לֹא תִדְרֹ֥שׁ שְׁלֹמָ֖ם וְטֹבָתָ֑ם כָּל יָמֶ֖יךָ לְעוֹלָֽם

verses.restored: You shall not abhor an Edomite, for he is your brother; you shall not abhor an Egyptian, for you were a sojourner in his land.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not abhor an Edomite; for he is thy brother: thou shalt not abhor an Egyptian; because thou wast a stranger in his land.

modern.text: Do not despise an Edomite, for he is your brother. Do not despise an Egyptian, because you lived as a foreigner in his land.

original.text: לֹֽא תְתַעֵ֣ב אֲדֹמִ֔י כִּ֥י אָחִ֖יךָ ה֑וּא לֹא תְתַעֵ֣ב מִצְרִ֔י כִּי גֵ֖ר הָיִ֥יתָ בְאַרְצֽוֹ

verses.restored: Children born to them in third generation may enter assembly of YHWH.

familiar.text: The children that are begotten of them shall enter into the congregation of the LORD in their third generation.

modern.text: The third generation of children born to them may enter the assembly of the LORD. Uncleanness in the Camp (Leviticus 15:1–12)

original.text: בָּנִ֛ים אֲשֶׁר יִוָּלְד֥וּ לָהֶ֖ם דּ֣וֹר שְׁלִישִׁ֑י יָבֹ֥א לָהֶ֖ם בִּקְהַ֥ל יְהוָֽה

verses.restored: When you go out as camp against your enemies, guard yourself from every evil thing.

familiar.text: When the host goeth forth against thine enemies, then keep thee from every wicked thing.

modern.text: When you are encamped against your enemies, then you shall keep yourself from every wicked thing.

original.text: כִּֽי תֵצֵ֥א מַחֲנֶ֖ה עַל אֹיְבֶ֑יךָ וְנִ֨שְׁמַרְתָּ֔ מִכֹּ֖ל דָּבָ֥ר רָֽע

verses.restored: If there is among you a man who is not clean because of occurrence at night, he shall go outside camp; he shall not enter midst of camp.

familiar.text: If there be among you any man, that is not clean by reason of uncleanness that chanceth him by night, then shall he go abroad out of the camp, he shall not come within the camp:

modern.text: If any man among you becomes unclean because of a nocturnal emission, he must leave the camp and stay outside.

original.text: כִּֽי יִהְיֶ֤ה בְךָ֙ אִ֔ישׁ אֲשֶׁ֛ר לֹא יִהְיֶ֥ה טָה֖וֹר מִקְּרֵה לָ֑יְלָה וְיָצָא֙ אֶל מִח֣וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֔ה לֹ֥א יָבֹ֖א אֶל תּ֥וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֶֽה

verses.restored: Toward turning of evening he shall wash in water, and when sun comes he may enter midst of camp.

familiar.text: But it shall be, when evening cometh on, he shall wash himself with water: and when the sun is down, he shall come into the camp again.

modern.text: When evening approaches, he must wash with water, and when the sun sets he may return to the camp.

original.text: וְהָיָ֥ה לִפְנֽוֹת עֶ֖רֶב יִרְחַ֣ץ בַּמָּ֑יִם וּכְבֹ֣א הַשֶּׁ֔מֶשׁ יָבֹ֖א אֶל תּ֥וֹךְ הַֽמַּחֲנֶה

verses.restored: A place shall be for you outside camp, and there you shall go out.

familiar.text: Thou shalt have a place also without the camp, whither thou shalt go forth abroad:

modern.text: You must have a place outside the camp to go and relieve yourself.

original.text: וְיָד֙ תִּהְיֶ֣ה לְךָ֔ מִח֖וּץ לַֽמַּחֲנֶ֑ה וְיָצָ֥אתָ שָׁ֖מָּה חֽוּץ

verses.restored: A peg shall be for you with your equipment; when you sit outside, you shall dig with it and turn and cover your excrement.

familiar.text: And thou shalt have a paddle upon thy weapon; and it shall be, when thou wilt ease thyself abroad, thou shalt dig therewith, and shalt turn back and cover that which cometh from thee:

modern.text: And you must have a digging tool in your equipment so that when you relieve yourself you can dig a hole and cover up your excrement.

original.text: וְיָתֵ֛ד תִּהְיֶ֥ה לְךָ֖ עַל אֲזֵנֶ֑ךָ וְהָיָה֙ בְּשִׁבְתְּךָ֣ ח֔וּץ וְחָפַרְתָּ֣ה בָ֔הּ וְשַׁבְתָּ֖ וְכִסִּ֥יתָ אֶת צֵאָתֶֽךָ

verses.restored: For YHWH your Divine walks in midst of your camp to rescue you and give your enemies before you; your camp shall be holy, so he sees no naked/indecent thing among you and turns away from you.

familiar.text: For the LORD thy God walketh in the midst of thy camp, to deliver thee, and to give up thine enemies before thee; therefore shall thy camp be holy: that he see no unclean thing in thee, and turn away from thee.

modern.text: For the LORD your God walks throughout your camp to protect you and deliver your enemies to you. Your camp must be holy, lest He see anything unclean among you and turn away from you. Miscellaneous Laws

original.text: כִּי֩ יְהוָ֨ה אֱלֹהֶ֜יךָ מִתְהַלֵּ֣ךְ בְּקֶ֣רֶב מַחֲנֶ֗ךָ לְהַצִּֽילְךָ֙ וְלָתֵ֤ת אֹיְבֶ֨יךָ֙ לְפָנֶ֔יךָ וְהָיָ֥ה מַחֲנֶ֖יךָ קָד֑וֹשׁ וְלֹֽא יִרְאֶ֤ה בְךָ֙ עֶרְוַ֣ת דָּבָ֔ר וְשָׁ֖ב מֵאַחֲרֶֽיךָ

verses.restored: You shall not deliver to his master a servant who escapes to you from his master.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not deliver unto his master the servant which is escaped from his master unto thee:

modern.text: Do not return a slave to his master if he has taken refuge with you.

original.text: לֹא תַסְגִּ֥יר עֶ֖בֶד אֶל אֲדֹנָ֑יו אֲשֶׁר יִנָּצֵ֥ל אֵלֶ֖יךָ מֵעִ֥ם אֲדֹנָֽיו

verses.restored: With you he shall dwell, in your midst, in place he chooses in one of your gates, where it is good for him; you shall not oppress him.

familiar.text: He shall dwell with thee, even among you, in that place which he shall choose in one of thy gates, where it liketh him best: thou shalt not oppress him.

modern.text: Let him live among you wherever he chooses, in the town of his pleasing. Do not oppress him.

original.text: עִמְּךָ֞ יֵשֵׁ֣ב בְּקִרְבְּךָ֗ בַּמָּק֧וֹם אֲשֶׁר יִבְחַ֛ר בְּאַחַ֥ד שְׁעָרֶ֖יךָ בַּטּ֣וֹב ל֑וֹ לֹ֖א תּוֹנֶֽנּוּ

verses.restored: There shall not be a female cult-prostitute from daughters of Israel, and there shall not be a male cult-prostitute from sons of Israel.

familiar.text: There shall be no whore of the daughters of Israel, nor a sodomite of the sons of Israel.

modern.text: No daughter or son of Israel is to be a shrine prostitute.

original.text: לֹא תִהְיֶ֥ה קְדֵשָׁ֖ה מִבְּנ֣וֹת יִשְׂרָאֵ֑ל וְלֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה קָדֵ֖שׁ מִבְּנֵ֥י יִשְׂרָאֵל

verses.restored: You shall not bring hire of a prostitute or price of a dog/male prostitute into house of YHWH your Divine for any vow, for both of them are an abomination to YHWH your Divine.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not bring the hire of a whore, or the price of a dog, into the house of the LORD thy God for any vow: for even both these are abomination unto the LORD thy God.

modern.text: You must not bring the wages of a prostitute, whether female or male, into the house of the LORD your God to fulfill any vow, because both are detestable to the LORD your God.

original.text: לֹא תָבִיא֩ אֶתְנַ֨ן זוֹנָ֜ה וּמְחִ֣יר כֶּ֗לֶב בֵּ֛ית יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ לְכָל נֶ֑דֶר כִּ֧י תוֹעֲבַ֛ת יְהוָ֥ה אֱלֹהֶ֖יךָ גַּם שְׁנֵיהֶֽם

verses.restored: You shall not charge interest to your brother—interest of silver, interest of food, interest of anything lent at interest.

familiar.text: Thou shalt not lend upon usury to thy brother; usury of money, usury of victuals, usury of any thing that is lent upon usury:

modern.text: Do not charge your brother interest on money, food, or any other type of loan.

original.text: לֹא תַשִּׁ֣יךְ לְאָחִ֔יךָ נֶ֥שֶׁךְ כֶּ֖סֶף נֶ֣שֶׁךְ אֹ֑כֶל נֶ֕שֶׁךְ כָּל דָּבָ֖ר אֲשֶׁ֥ר יִשָּֽׁךְ

verses.restored: To foreigner you may charge interest, but to your brother you shall not charge interest, so YHWH your Divine may bless you in every undertaking of your hand upon land where you enter to possess it.

familiar.text: Unto a stranger thou mayest lend upon usury; but unto thy brother thou shalt not lend upon usury: that the LORD thy God may bless thee in all that thou settest thine hand to in the land whither thou goest to possess it.

modern.text: You may charge a foreigner interest, but not your brother, so that the LORD your God may bless you in everything to which you put your hand in the land that you are entering to possess.

original.text: לַנָּכְרִ֣י תַשִּׁ֔יךְ וּלְאָחִ֖יךָ לֹ֣א תַשִּׁ֑יךְ לְמַ֨עַן יְבָרֶכְךָ֜ יְהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֗יךָ בְּכֹל֙ מִשְׁלַ֣ח יָדֶ֔ךָ עַל הָאָ֕רֶץ אֲשֶׁר אַתָּ֥ה בָא שָׁ֖מָּה לְרִשְׁתָּֽהּ

verses.restored: When you vow a vow to YHWH your Divine, you shall not delay to fulfill it, for YHWH your Divine will surely require it from you, and sin/misalignment would be in you.

familiar.text: When thou shalt vow a vow unto the LORD thy God, thou shalt not slack to pay it: for the LORD thy God will surely require it of thee; and it would be sin in thee.

modern.text: If you make a vow to the LORD your God, do not be slow to keep it, because He will surely require it of you, and you will be guilty of sin.

original.text: כִּֽי תִדֹּ֥ר נֶ֨דֶר֙ לַיהוָ֣ה אֱלֹהֶ֔יךָ לֹ֥א תְאַחֵ֖ר לְשַׁלְּמ֑וֹ כִּֽי דָּרֹ֨שׁ יִדְרְשֶׁ֜נּוּ יְהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ מֵֽעִמָּ֔ךְ וְהָיָ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא

verses.restored: But if you refrain from vowing, sin/misalignment shall not be in you.

familiar.text: But if thou shalt forbear to vow, it shall be no sin in thee.

modern.text: But if you refrain from making a vow, you will not be guilty of sin.

original.text: וְכִ֥י תֶחְדַּ֖ל לִנְדֹּ֑ר לֹֽא יִהְיֶ֥ה בְךָ֖ חֵֽטְא

verses.restored: What goes out from your lips you shall keep and do, according to what you vowed to YHWH your Divine as freewill offering, which you spoke with your mouth.

familiar.text: That which is gone out of thy lips thou shalt keep and perform; even a freewill offering, according as thou hast vowed unto the LORD thy God, which thou hast promised with thy mouth.

modern.text: Be careful to follow through on what comes from your lips, because you have freely vowed to the LORD your God with your own mouth.

original.text: מוֹצָ֥א שְׂפָתֶ֖יךָ תִּשְׁמֹ֣ר וְעָשִׂ֑יתָ כַּאֲשֶׁ֨ר נָדַ֜רְתָּ לַיהוָ֤ה אֱלֹהֶ֨יךָ֙ נְדָבָ֔ה אֲשֶׁ֥ר דִּבַּ֖רְתָּ בְּפִֽיךָ

verses.restored: When you enter vineyard of your neighbor, you may eat grapes according to your soul/life, to your fill, but into your vessel you shall not put any.

familiar.text: When thou comest into thy neighbour’s vineyard, then thou mayest eat grapes thy fill at thine own pleasure; but thou shalt not put any in thy vessel.

modern.text: When you enter your neighbor’s vineyard, you may eat your fill of grapes, but you must not put any in your basket.

original.text: כִּ֤י תָבֹא֙ בְּכֶ֣רֶם רֵעֶ֔ךָ וְאָכַלְתָּ֧ עֲנָבִ֛ים כְּנַפְשְׁךָ֖ שָׂבְעֶ֑ךָ וְאֶֽל כֶּלְיְךָ֖ לֹ֥א תִתֵּֽן

verses.restored: When you enter standing grain of your neighbor, you may pluck heads with your hand, but sickle you shall not swing upon standing grain of your neighbor.

familiar.text: When thou comest into the standing corn of thy neighbour, then thou mayest pluck the ears with thine hand; but thou shalt not move a sickle unto thy neighbour’s standing corn.

modern.text: When you enter your neighbor’s grainfield, you may pluck the heads of grain with your hand, but you must not put a sickle to your neighbor’s grain.

original.text: כִּ֤י תָבֹא֙ בְּקָמַ֣ת רֵעֶ֔ךָ וְקָטַפְתָּ֥ מְלִילֹ֖ת בְּיָדֶ֑ךָ וְחֶרְמֵשׁ֙ לֹ֣א תָנִ֔יף עַ֖ל קָמַ֥ת רֵעֶֽךָ

translation_notes: Assembly exclusions based on genital injury and birth status are ancient purity/kinship rules that must not be applied to eunuchs, intersex people, transgender people, infertile people, adopted people, or children born outside approved unions. Isaiah 56 later explicitly imagines faithful eunuchs receiving an enduring name.
Mamzer is a technical and debated status term, not a general insult equivalent to modern 'illegitimate child.' No child bears moral shame for circumstances of birth.
Ammonite and Moabite collective exclusion stands in tension with other biblical traditions, especially Ruth the Moabite, and must not support ethnic hatred.
The camp rules combine ritual status with practical sanitation. Nocturnal emission is not moral guilt.
Verses 15-16 provide extraordinary asylum to an escaped slave: the person must not be returned, may choose where to live, and may not be oppressed.
Qadesh/qedeshah refers to cultic sexual roles, though exact historical practice is debated. The language must not be used to demean sex workers or LGBTQ people.
The in-group/foreigner interest distinction reflects unequal ancient economics and cannot justify predatory lending to immigrants or outsiders.
Neighbor-crop access permits immediate hunger relief while limiting commercial harvesting.
safety_note: Do not use Deuteronomy 23 to exclude people because of genitals, infertility, gender identity, ancestry, birth circumstances, ethnicity, sexual history, or disability. Never return an escaped person to slavery or abuse. Center asylum, chosen residence, non-oppression, honest vows, protection from predatory interest, sanitation, and limited food access for the hungry.
